property_summary: For any call to setOwner, if the caller is the current owner the call succeeds and state changes; if the caller is not the owner the call must revert (rule: `success == (caller == previousOwner)`). The buggy modifier removes the ownership check so non-owner calls succeed, violating this invariant by returning true and updating owner when it should revert.
change_summary: Replace msg.sender == owner with true so the modifier always passes.
